g.text: ChatGPT — Docker and Secure MCP Tunnel
Queues MCP requests and relays responses
Docker container — started with pnpm docker:up
Outbound HTTPS: poll requests / post responses
Outbound connections only · No Docker ports published · Runtime configuration from .env
